title: Counter loop configuration
statement: Given a machine configuration $c$ on input $x$ with $k$ work tapes, an optional counter-loop state $q$, a counter-tape content function $ct:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Symbol})$, and a counter-head position $cp\in\mathbb{Z}$, form a configuration on the same input with $k+1$ work tapes. Its first $k$ tapes, their head positions, the input-head position, and output are those of $c$, its added tape and head position are $ct$ and $cp$, and its state is $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol type and a state set $S$
A configuration $c$ on $x$ with $k$ work tapes
